title: Public Offer
description: Caviar Berry public contract for the sale of goods and personal data processing.

paragraphs: This document constitutes a public offer (the “Offer”) by Individual Entrepreneur Olha Anatoliivna Yurkovska to enter into a public contract for the sale of goods concluded at a distance (via the online store located at https://caviar.net.ua/) on the terms and conditions set out below. This Offer has been prepared in accordance with Articles 633, 634, 641 and 642 of the Civil Code of Ukraine, the Laws of Ukraine “On Electronic Commerce”, “On Consumer Protection”, “On Personal Data Protection” and “On Information for Consumers on Food Products”, and other legislative acts of Ukraine.

sections.title: 1. Definitions
paragraphs: • Seller means Individual Entrepreneur Olha Anatoliivna Yurkovska (Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN): 2805800227; registered address: 25V Liubomyrska Street, Kyiv, 03131, Ukraine; tel.: +38 098 194 4248 and +38 067 238 3067; email: sale@caviar.net.ua).
• Buyer means any natural person with full legal capacity, individual entrepreneur or legal entity that has accepted the terms of this Offer and placed an Order on the Website.

• Website means the Seller’s online store located at https://caviar.net.ua/. • Goods means food products, namely granular sturgeon caviar, granular salmon roe, and gift sets based thereon (food products sold in sets); the composition and characteristics of each item are specified on the Website.
• Order means the Buyer’s electronic request for the purchase of selected Goods, duly completed and submitted via the Website.
• Acceptance means the Buyer’s full and unconditional acceptance of the terms of this Offer in the manner set out in Clause 5.3 of this Offer.

• Contract means the contract for the sale of Goods concluded between the Seller and the Buyer on the terms of this Offer. • Parties means the Seller and the Buyer, and each of them individually, a Party.

sections.title: 2. General Provisions
paragraphs: 2.1. The Contract concluded on the terms of this Offer is a public contract (Article 633 of the Civil Code of Ukraine) and a contract of adhesion (Article 634 of the Civil Code of Ukraine). The terms of the Offer are the same for all Buyers, except where the Seller runs publicly available promotions, the terms of which are published on the Website.

2.2. The provisions of this Offer establishing consumer rights under the Law of Ukraine “On Consumer Protection” apply to Buyers who are natural persons purchasing the Goods for personal needs not related to business activities or the performance of duties as an employee. All other provisions of this Offer apply to all Buyers. Relations with Buyers who are individual entrepreneurs or legal entities shall, to the extent not governed by this Offer, be governed by the Civil Code of Ukraine, unless otherwise separately agreed by the Parties.

2.3. By placing an Order, the Buyer confirms that, prior to the conclusion of the Contract, the Buyer has read the terms of this Offer and the information on the Goods, the Seller, the price, and the payment and delivery terms.

sections.title: 3. Subject Matter of the Contract
paragraphs: 3.1. The Seller undertakes to transfer the ordered Goods into the ownership of the Buyer, and the Buyer undertakes to accept and pay for the Goods on the terms of this Offer.

3.2. The Seller warrants that the Goods comply with the mandatory requirements of the legislation of Ukraine on the safety and certain quality parameters of food products, as well as with the information about the Goods published on the Website.

3.3. The Seller shall ensure proper conditions for the receipt, storage, packaging and preparation of the Goods for dispatch in compliance with the established requirements regarding the temperature regime, shelf life and storage conditions of the Goods.

sections.title: 4. Information on the Goods
paragraphs: 4.1. Before an Order is placed, the Seller shall ensure that the mandatory food information required by the Law of Ukraine “On Information for Consumers on Food Products” is published on the page of the relevant Goods on the Website, including:

• the exact name of the food product, indicating its physical condition and method of processing; • the list of ingredients and the nutrition declaration; • clearly highlighted allergens or substances causing food intolerances; • the quantity (net weight); • the country / place of origin of the product; • the name and address of the food business operator responsible for the product information (manufacturer / packer / importer);

• storage conditions and temperature regime; • the price and information on whether taxes are included in the price. The scope of the information shall be determined with due regard to the type, characteristics and specific features of the relevant Goods.

4.2. Complete mandatory information on the Goods, including the “best before” date or the “use by” date, is shown on the labelling of the Goods in accordance with the requirements of the legislation of Ukraine. The Buyer shall read the information shown on the labelling of the Goods before consuming them and shall comply with the storage and use conditions established by the manufacturer.

sections.title: 5. Procedure for Placing an Order and Concluding the Contract
paragraphs: 5.1. The Buyer places an Order on the Website by selecting the Goods and completing the Order form.
5.2. To place an Order, the Buyer provides: surname, first name and patronymic; a valid telephone number; email address; delivery address or the carrier’s branch number; and the payment method.

5.3. Acceptance of this Offer occurs when the Buyer clicks the “Confirm Order” button (or any other button of similar meaning) on the Website after reading the terms of this Offer and confirming agreement with them. The Contract shall be deemed concluded from the moment this action is performed. The Buyer confirms that, prior to Acceptance, the Buyer had the opportunity to review the characteristics of the Goods, their price, the payment and delivery terms, the procedure for withdrawal
from the Contract (Section 9 of this Offer) and the provisions of this Offer.

5.4. Upon receipt of an Order, the Seller sends the Buyer a confirmation of its receipt by SMS, messenger or email. The Order confirmation contains information on the name and quantity of the ordered Goods, their price, the total amount payable, the selected payment method, the estimated dispatch time, the packaging’s temperature-holding capacity (Clause 7.7), the date of the version of the Offer on the terms of which the Contract was concluded, and any other information necessary for the fulfilment of the Order. Confirmation of the conclusion of the electronic Contract is provided to the Buyer in the form and manner prescribed by the legislation of Ukraine.

5.5. If the ordered Goods are unavailable or the Order cannot be fulfilled, the Seller shall promptly notify the Buyer thereof and may offer to substitute Goods of a similar purpose with characteristics and quality no lower than those of the ordered Goods. Substitution shall be made only with the Buyer’s prior consent. If the Buyer does not agree to the substitution, the Order shall be cancelled and the amount paid shall be refunded to the Buyer within 7 (seven) calendar days from the date of cancellation.

sections.title: 6. Price of the Goods and Payment Terms
paragraphs: 6.1. Prices for the Goods are shown on the Website in the national currency of Ukraine, the hryvnia. Prices include all taxes and duties provided for by the legislation of Ukraine.
6.2. The price of the Goods and the total amount of the Order are displayed to the Buyer before the “Confirm Order” button is clicked.
6.3. The Seller may change the prices of the Goods by updating the information on the Website. A price change shall not apply to Orders for which the Contract has already been concluded.
6.4. The Goods may be paid for by the following methods:

• online cashless payment via the payment services integrated into the Website (internet acquiring); • bank transfer to the Seller’s current account (IBAN) specified in Section 15 of this Offer. The Goods shall be dispatched after the funds have been credited to the Seller’s account or confirmation of successful payment has been received from the payment service. If technical errors are identified while an Order is being placed, no confirmation of payment is received from the payment service, or the Buyer provides incorrect or incomplete contact details that make dispatch of the Goods impossible, the Seller shall contact the Buyer to clarify the details and may suspend fulfilment of the Order for up to 3 (three) business days until the circumstances are clarified. If it is impossible to contact the Buyer or to fulfil the Order, the Order shall be cancelled and the amount paid shall be refunded to the Buyer in the manner and within the time limit set out in Clause 5.5 of this Offer.

6.5. The Seller shall provide the Buyer with a settlement document (fiscal receipt), including in electronic form, in the cases and manner provided for by the legislation on the use of cash registers, as well as electronic confirmation of the electronic transaction in accordance with the Law of Ukraine “On Electronic Commerce”.

sections.title: 7. Delivery and Transfer of the Goods
paragraphs: 7.1. The Goods are delivered by Nova Poshta LLC within the territory of Ukraine, except for temporarily occupied territories and areas of active hostilities, where delivery is not possible.

7.2. The Seller shall dispatch the Goods within 1–2 business days after the funds have been credited to the Seller’s account or confirmation of successful payment has been received from the payment service. The actual delivery time is determined by the carrier’s rules.

7.3. The Seller shall notify the Buyer of the dispatch of the Goods and of the consignment note (tracking) number. The delivery cost is calculated at the carrier’s rates and is payable by the Buyer, unless otherwise provided by the terms of promotions on the Website.

7.4. The Seller shall pack the Goods in specialised insulated packaging (a thermal box) with cooling elements or other means of maintaining the temperature regime for the Agreed Collection Period set out in Clause 7.7 of this Offer.

7.5. If the Goods are not handed over or delivered for reasons attributable to the Buyer (in particular, provision of incorrect details, absence of the recipient, failure to attend the carrier’s branch, or failure to collect the Goods within the period set out in Clause 7.7 of this Offer):

• the costs of delivery, return or storage of the Goods shall be borne by the Buyer; • the Seller may withhold refund of the price of the Goods (in whole or in part) only if the Seller proves that: the Goods were properly packed and handed over to the carrier in accordance with Clause 7.4 of this Offer; and the deterioration in quality or loss of consumer properties of the Goods resulted specifically from the Buyer’s failure to collect, or late collection of, the Goods for reasons attributable to the Buyer. The amount withheld must be justified and may not exceed the price of the Goods that have lost their consumer properties;

• the consequences of late collection shall apply only where the following are established: circumstances attributable to the Buyer; proper notification that the consignment was ready for collection; a real opportunity to collect the Goods within the agreed period; and a causal link between the Buyer’s delay and the deterioration in quality. Delays by the carrier or insufficient temperature-holding capacity of the packaging shall not be attributed to the Buyer.

7.6. The risk of accidental loss of or accidental damage to the Goods passes to the Buyer from the moment the consignment is actually handed over to the Buyer or to a person authorised by the Buyer. If, for reasons attributable to the Buyer, the Buyer fails to collect the Goods within the Agreed Collection Period (Clause 7.7), the risk of spoilage of the Goods due to the expiry of the packaging’s temperature-holding capacity passes to the Buyer upon expiry of that period, provided that all of the following conditions are met:
• the Seller properly packed the Goods and handed them over to the carrier in accordance with Clause 7.4;
• the Buyer was sent the dispatch notification (Clause 7.3) and the carrier’s notification that the consignment had arrived at the branch or was ready for courier delivery;
• the Buyer had a real opportunity to collect the Goods within the agreed period.

7.7. Given the perishable nature of the Goods, the Buyer shall collect the consignment as soon as possible after receiving the carrier’s notification of its arrival, and in any event no later than the Agreed Collection Period. The Agreed Collection Period is determined on the basis of the confirmed temperature-holding capacity of the packaging, calculated from the moment of packing until actual handover, including transit time. The Seller shall specify the exact date and time at which the Agreed Collection Period

expires in the dispatch notification (Clause 7.3). The carrier’s free storage period for the consignment and the shelf life of the Goods shown on the labelling do not constitute the period for collecting the consignment.

7.8. The Buyer is advised to inspect the Goods upon receipt in the presence of a carrier’s representative. If damage to the integrity of the thermal box or a breach of the packaging seal is found, the Buyer may refuse to accept the consignment. The Buyer shall draw up a damage report together with the carrier’s representative and notify the Seller thereof (preferably upon receipt or within 3 (three) hours of handover), providing photo or video evidence.

7.9. Delivery times of the Goods by the carrier are indicative and are determined in accordance with the terms and rules of the relevant carrier. The Seller shall not be liable for the carrier’s failure to meet delivery times where such failure arises from reasons beyond the Seller’s control, provided that the Seller has duly and timely performed its obligations regarding the preparation, packaging and handover of the Goods to the carrier. In the event of a delivery delay, the Seller shall, where possible, assist the Buyer in obtaining information on the location of the consignment and shall liaise with the carrier within the scope of its authority. The above limitation of liability for delivery delays does not release the Seller from the obligation to deliver Goods of proper quality to the Buyer or to refund the amount paid in the cases provided for by the legislation of Ukraine and this Offer. The allocation of risks is governed by Clauses 7.5–7.6 of this Offer. The settlement of relations between the Seller and the carrier is not a condition for satisfying the Buyer’s lawful claims.

sections.title: 8. Quality of the Goods and Claims Procedure
paragraphs: 8.1. If Goods of improper quality are delivered to the Buyer, the Buyer shall have the rights provided for by the legislation of Ukraine. Goods of improper quality include, in particular: • Goods whose factory packaging seal is broken at the time of transfer to the Buyer; • Goods whose shelf life has expired at the time of transfer to the Buyer; • Goods whose safety or quality deteriorated before transfer to the Buyer as a result of a breach of storage or transportation conditions;
• Goods whose characteristics do not correspond to the information provided to the Buyer prior to the conclusion of the Contract.

The Seller shall not be liable for defects in the Goods arising after their transfer to the Buyer as a result of the Buyer’s breach of the conditions of storage, transportation, use or consumption of the Goods, damage to the packaging, acts of third parties or other circumstances for which the Seller is not responsible, provided that such circumstances and the causal link between them and the occurrence of the defects are proven. The quality of the Goods shall be assessed with due regard to their type, characteristics, storage conditions, shelf life and the manufacturer’s information.
8.2. If external damage to the Goods, a breach of packaging integrity, signs of a breach of the temperature regime or other defects are found, the Buyer is advised to notify the Seller immediately,

preferably upon receipt of the Goods or within 3 (three) hours of handover. For a claim to be considered, the Buyer shall send the Seller a request stating the Order number and describing the defects found and, where possible, attaching:

• photo or video evidence of the defects; • a photo of the labelling of the Goods showing the batch number and date of manufacture; • the carrier’s damage report for the consignment (if any). Until the claim has been considered, the Buyer is advised to keep the Goods and their packaging under proper storage conditions, provided that this does not contravene food safety requirements or pose a health risk. If the Goods cannot be kept for safety reasons, the Buyer shall, where possible, record the relevant circumstances by photo or video and notify the Seller thereof. Failure to provide particular materials or late notification of defects shall be taken into account when considering the claim insofar as it affects the ability to establish the causes of the defects, but shall not deprive the Buyer of the rights provided for by the legislation of Ukraine.
8.3. The Seller shall consider the Buyer’s claims within the time limits and in the manner established by the legislation of Ukraine. To establish the causes of defects, the Seller may:

• request additional documents, explanations, photographs and video recordings from the Buyer; • carry out a quality inspection of the Goods; • initiate an expert examination involving appropriate specialists; • verify compliance with the storage and transportation conditions of the Goods; • contact the manufacturer or other responsible persons to obtain information on the relevant batch of Goods.

The Buyer has the right to participate in the quality inspection of the Goods in accordance with the legislation of Ukraine. Following consideration of the claim, the Seller shall notify the Buyer of its decision. If the improper quality of the Goods is confirmed and there are grounds provided for by law, the Seller shall satisfy the Buyer’s lawful claims for replacement of the Goods or a refund. If the alleged defects are not confirmed, or circumstances for which the Seller is not responsible are established, the Seller may reject the claim, providing the Buyer with the reasons for its decision.

8.4. The Seller shall not be liable for any deterioration in quality, spoilage or loss of consumer properties of the Goods arising after their actual transfer to the Buyer as a result of the Buyer’s failure to comply with storage conditions, the temperature regime or consumption periods, damage to the packaging, or other breaches of the rules for handling the Goods, where such circumstances and their causal link to the defects are supported by proper evidence.

sections.title: 9. Exchange of Goods of Proper Quality and Withdrawal from the Contract
paragraphs: 9.1. Food products of proper quality are not subject to exchange (return) in accordance with the List approved by Resolution of the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine No. 172 dated 19 March 1994. The Seller does not grant any additional contractual right to return received Goods of proper quality merely because the Buyer has changed their mind about the purchase. Before the Goods are transferred, the Buyer may withdraw from the Contract in the cases and on the terms established by the legislation of Ukraine, in particular Part 3 of Article 702 of the Civil Code of Ukraine, subject to reimbursing the Seller for the costs related to the performance of the Contract as provided for by that provision. The Seller shall provide justification and documentary evidence of such costs. The provisions of this Clause do not limit the Buyer’s rights in the event of delivery of Goods of improper quality, non-conformity of the Goods with the Order, non-delivery of paid Goods or in other cases established by the legislation of Ukraine, nor do they affect the refunds provided for in Clauses 5.5, 6.4, 11.4 and 11.5 of this Offer.

sections.title: 10. Rights and Obligations of the Parties
paragraphs: 10.1. The Seller undertakes to:
• deliver to the Buyer Goods that comply with the mandatory requirements of the legislation of Ukraine on the safety and quality of food products and with the terms of the Contract;

• provide the Buyer with complete, accurate and up-to-date information on the Goods; • ensure proper conditions for the storage, packaging and preparation of the Goods for dispatch; • notify the Buyer in a timely manner of the dispatch of the Goods and of the consignment note number;

• consider the Buyer’s claims within the time limits established by law; • ensure the protection of the Buyer’s personal data in accordance with the legislation of Ukraine; • perform other obligations provided for by this Offer and the legislation of Ukraine.
10.2. The Buyer undertakes to:

• provide accurate and up-to-date information required for placing and delivering the Order; • pay for the Goods in a timely manner using the selected payment method; • ensure that the Goods are collected at the specified address or at the relevant carrier’s branch within the period set out in Clause 7.7 of this Offer;
• upon receipt, where possible, check the integrity of the packaging and the conformity of the Goods with the Order;
• after receipt of the Goods, comply with the storage and use conditions indicated on the labelling.

10.3. The Buyer is responsible for the accuracy, completeness and currency of the information provided when placing the Order, in particular the contact telephone number, delivery address and other details necessary for the proper performance of the Contract. If any errors or inaccuracies in the details provided are discovered, the Buyer shall notify the Seller thereof immediately, before the Goods are dispatched.

The Seller shall not be liable for the impossibility of delivery or for delays in delivery resulting from the Buyer’s provision of inaccurate, incomplete or erroneous details, provided that the Seller is not at fault.

10.4. After receiving the Goods, the Buyer shall ensure their proper storage in accordance with the temperature regime, shelf life and other conditions shown on the labelling of the Goods. The risk of deterioration in the quality of the Goods resulting from the Buyer’s failure to comply with these requirements after the actual transfer of the Goods shall be borne by the Buyer to the extent established by the legislation of Ukraine.

sections.title: 11. Liability of the Parties and Force Majeure
paragraphs: 11.1. For non-performance or improper performance of their obligations under the Contract, the Parties shall be liable in accordance with this Offer and the legislation of Ukraine. The Seller is responsible for the proper performance of its obligations regarding the quality of the Goods, their packaging, preparation for dispatch and handover to the carrier in accordance with the agreed delivery terms.

11.2. The Parties shall be released from liability for full or partial non-performance of their obligations under the Contract if such non-performance results from force majeure circumstances that arose after the conclusion of the Contract, are beyond the Party’s reasonable control and objectively make performance of its obligations impossible. Such circumstances may include military operations, blockades, acts of terrorism, natural disasters, fires, accidents, prolonged power outages, decisions of public authorities and other extraordinary and unavoidable circumstances.

11.3. A Party affected by force majeure shall notify the other Party of its occurrence without delay as soon as it becomes possible to do so. Given the perishable nature of the Goods, the Seller shall notify the Buyer of such circumstances no later than 24 (twenty-four) hours after becoming aware of them.

11.4. If force majeure makes it impossible to fulfil the Order, the Order shall be cancelled and the amount paid by the Buyer for the unfulfilled Order shall be refunded within 7 (seven) calendar days from the date of cancellation using the same method by which payment was made, unless otherwise agreed by the Parties.

11.5. If circumstances arise that objectively make delivery of the Goods impossible or substantially more difficult, in particular temporary closure of the carrier’s branch, restrictions on transport links or other logistical obstacles, the Seller shall notify the Buyer thereof and propose to agree an alternative delivery method or time. If the Parties do not agree on an alternative delivery method or time, or fulfilment of the Order is impossible, the Order shall be cancelled and the amount paid by the Buyer shall be refunded in the manner and within the time limit set out in Clause 11.4 of this Offer.

sections.title: 12. Personal Data Protection
paragraphs: 12.1. Personal data are processed in accordance with the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”. The Seller is the controller of the personal data. This Section constitutes a notice of personal data processing and applies to Buyers, as well as to natural persons who contact the Seller, request a call-back or subscribe to communications via the forms available on the Website, regardless of whether a Contract is concluded.

12.2. Purposes of processing: conclusion and performance of the Contract, arranging delivery of the Goods, making settlements, handling requests and claims, and compliance with the requirements of the

legislation of Ukraine. Data provided for a consultation or call-back are used to handle the relevant request and respond to it. Data for marketing subscriptions are processed separately on the terms of Clause 12.8 of this Section.

12.3. To place and fulfil an Order, the following data are processed: surname, first name and patronymic; telephone number; email address; delivery address or carrier’s branch number; and Order history. For a consultation, call-back or the handling of a request, the following are processed: name, the contact details provided by the person, the content of the request and the information necessary to handle it. For a marketing subscription: the contact chosen by the person for receiving communications and records of the giving and withdrawal of consent. In each case, only the data necessary for the relevant purpose are collected; mandatory fields are marked in the form.

12.4. Personal data may be disclosed only to the extent necessary to achieve the purpose of processing set out in Clause 12.2 of this Offer, to the following recipients: postal operators and delivery services; banks and payment service providers; providers of hosting, IT, SMS and messenger services that process personal data on behalf of the Seller; and public authorities in cases expressly provided for by law. Personal data are not disclosed to third parties for any other purposes without the Buyer’s consent.

12.5. Order data are retained for the period necessary to perform the Contract, to protect rights within the applicable limitation periods and to comply with statutory document retention obligations. Data relating to requests that did not result in an Order are retained for the period necessary to handle the request and resolve related matters. Marketing subscription data are used until the person unsubscribes or withdraws consent; records necessary to evidence consent and to honour an opt-out may be retained where there is a lawful basis to do so. Once the purpose of processing has ceased and the mandatory retention periods have expired, the data are destroyed or anonymised.

12.6. A data subject has the rights provided for by Article 8 of the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”, including the right to: know the sources of collection and the location of their data, the purpose of processing, the controller and the recipients; access their data and obtain information on their processing; submit a reasoned objection to processing; demand that data be changed or destroyed if they are processed unlawfully or are inaccurate; withdraw consent to processing carried out on the basis of consent; and lodge complaints with the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights or the courts and seek legal remedies. The data subject also has the right to make reservations restricting processing when giving consent, to know the logic of automated processing, and to be protected against an automated decision producing legal effects concerning them. Requests regarding personal data are accepted at sale@caviar.net.ua or via the other contact details set out in Section 15 and are handled in the manner and within the time limits established by law. Withdrawal of consent does not terminate processing for which another lawful basis exists, in particular the obligation to retain settlement documents.

12.7. The legal bases for processing are the conclusion and performance of a transaction, the taking of steps at the data subject’s request prior to its conclusion, compliance with a legal obligation of the Seller, and, where applicable, the data subject’s voluntary informed consent or another basis provided for by Article 11 of the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”. Processing of data for the purpose of fulfilling an Order does not constitute automatic consent to marketing communications.

12.8. If a subscription to news, promotions or other marketing communications is available on the Website, it is effected through a separate voluntary action by the person confirming their consent to such subscription. Declining a marketing subscription does not prevent the placing of an Order. A person may unsubscribe by the method indicated in the communication or by writing to
sale@caviar.net.ua. After unsubscribing, marketing communications cease; necessary notifications regarding the fulfilment of an Order may continue to be sent.

12.9. The information in this Section is provided to the data subject at the time their personal data are collected. An accessible link to this Section is provided next to the relevant forms on the Website so that the person can read it before submitting their data. Submitting a request or subscribing to marketing communications does not in itself constitute acceptance of the sale terms of this Offer.

12.10. If analytics, advertising or other third-party technologies involving the processing of visitors’ personal data are used on the Website, the Seller shall, before such data collection begins, give notice of the services actually used, the categories of data, the purpose, the legal bases, the recipients and the retention periods, by supplementing this Section and, where necessary, by a notice next to the relevant element of the Website. Where processing is based on consent, it shall begin only after such consent has been obtained. Merely visiting the Website or accepting the Offer shall not be deemed consent to any unspecified processing of data.

sections.title: 13. Dispute Resolution
paragraphs: 13.1. Disputes and disagreements under the Contract shall be resolved through negotiations, including by way of the claims procedure set out in Section 8 of this Offer.
13.2. If no agreement is reached, the dispute shall be resolved by a court in accordance with the legislation of Ukraine.
13.3. The Buyer also has the right to seek protection of their rights from the State Service of Ukraine on Food Safety and Consumer Protection (Derzhprodspozhyvsluzhba) and its territorial bodies.

sections.title: 14. Term of the Contract and Amendment of the Offer
paragraphs: 14.1. The Contract is effective from the moment of its conclusion until the Parties have fully performed their obligations.
14.2. The Offer enters into force upon its publication on the Website and remains in effect until withdrawn by the Seller.

14.3. The Seller may amend the terms of the Offer by publishing a new version on the Website indicating the date of that version. The new version shall not apply to Contracts concluded before its publication.
